parameters.moonSizeAlternatives: Historical assumed geometric albedo0.04/0.02 gives diameters175/250km; spherical heights87.5/125km are model alternatives, not measured axes or normals.
parameters.sourceCrosswalk: Primary radius and circular orbit from Bamberger2509.05880v3; historical moon size alternatives from Parker1604.07461v1. This combines distinct research assumptions, not a jointly fitted physical solution.

geometry.limits: Angular outputs only; irradiance and colour discarded. Near-side camera assumed. Preliminary circular separation minus model sphere height is not dated distance, registered site normal, verified rotation/tidal locking or permanent Makemake-facing site. Alternatives are not an uncertainty envelope; orbital/primary radius errors are not propagated here. No rendered disk or measured raster diameter adopted.

scienceLimits: Unresolved HST point and system MIRI photometry do not establish resolved moon terrain, local chemistry, visible colour or moon temperature.
Primary thermal hotspot/ring models and primary rotation alternatives must not be assigned to the moon.
Prograde/retrograde orbit ambiguity does not determine moon spin; mutual events remain conditional predictions, not verified ongoing events.
Black sky, absent rings or omitted haze are not absence measurements. Camera phase, exposure, spectral transfer and transmission remain artistic until independently verified.
Parker record nonexclusive distribution is not CC BY. Bamberger specific record CC BY-SA4 does not establish blanket source/raw-product licence; no figure embedded.
